summary: Rechecked the official Tables S1-S7, retrieved via Europe PMC because the PMC link returned an HTML challenge. Table S4 has seven DESeq2 sheets: cell type, age neuron (pooled sex), age glia, and four male-versus-female sheets. None is a female-only P35-versus-P12 neuron effect. The GEO RAW.tar holds only WGBS coverage, so the archived group_neuron35f_vs_neuron12f model cannot be rebuilt from author counts. The registered female-only limma-on-VSD comparison and the pooled-sex DESeq2 S4b differ in cohort and effect definition. The existing not_comparable review stands, so no metrics were computed and no entries are proposed.
